It's true.
The Dragon's Breath Constructed Deck event is on Thursday.
The Sabbat Draft event is Saturday at 1pm.

Someone besides myself is also running a DCI booster draft (with
Jyhad boosters) event called "Unnatural Disaster" at 1pm on Friday.

Three days, three tournaments.
